news.analysis: Allen opened the scoring with a one-yard rush in first quarter and found DJ Moore and Dalton Kincaid on passing touchdowns to ice the game in the fourth quarter. news.contents: Josh Allen completed 21-of-34 passes for 289 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He rushed for 30 yards and a touchdown on seven attempts.
